prompt: Vertical candid photo, close shot of the wide inside ledge of a corner shop's front window at night, a dusty painted wooden ledge with a few dead flies. A single loaf of plain white sliced bread in a clear plastic bag with a twisted end sits on the ledge, filling much of the frame. To its right, with a clear gap of bare ledge between them, lies one small chocolate bar in a plain purple wrapper with no logo, no words and no print. Directly behind them is the window glass, filling the upper part of the frame, pitch black outside with a faint smear of condensation, nothing visible through it. Two plain white price cards are taped flat and square onto the vertical front lip of the ledge, facing the camera straight on, not bent, not overlapping anything and well apart: a larger card directly under the loaf reading "£5", and a wide landscape card directly under the chocolate bar reading "10p", both handwritten in thick black marker. Lit from behind the camera by a cold teal fluorescent tube. Shot on cheap colour negative film at night, coarse grain, soft focus, muted teal cast, deep blacks. No people, no hands, no reflections of people. Thanks.
